_comment: The Isle: Evrima (Windows-native / winproc). SteamCMD app 412680 -beta evrima into the server ROOT (SteamCMD in daemon TEMP, run twice). Launches the REAL UE4 server binary directly (TheIsle/Binaries/Win64/TheIsleServer-Win64-Shipping.exe) with -stdout so logs reach the console; the 0.3MB root launcher is bypassed. Install also runs UE4PrereqSetup (VC++ redist) and writes the STATIC EOS credentials to TheIsle\Saved\Config\WindowsServer\Engine.ini. NOTE: the Shipping exe path is assumed identical to Legacy; if the install logs 'WARNING: Shipping exe NOT found', check the actual path and adjust the startup. Ports: game/query 7777 UDP.
name: The Isle: Evrima (Windows)
author: test@feathers.local
description: The Isle (Evrima branch) dedicated server for Windows-native winproc nodes. Installs ~70GB via SteamCMD app 412680 (evrima branch) into the server root, installs UE4 prerequisites, writes EOS credentials to Engine.ini, and launches the Shipping server binary directly.

config.startup: {"done":["Match State Changed from WaitingToStart to InProgress"]}

installation.script:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$dir = (Get-Location).Path
$sc = Join-Path $env:TEMP ('feathers-steamcmd-' + $env:P_SERVER_UUID)
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $sc | Out-Null
$zip = Join-Path $sc 'steamcmd.zip'
Write-Output 'Downloading SteamCMD...'
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd.zip' -OutFile $zip
Expand-Archive -Path $zip -DestinationPath $sc -Force
$steam = Join-Path $sc 'steamcmd.exe'
Write-Output 'Bootstrapping SteamCMD (self-update)...'
& $steam +quit
Write-Output 'Installing The Isle: Evrima (app 412680, branch evrima). This downloads ~70GB and can take a while...'
& $steam +force_install_dir $dir +login anonymous +app_update 412680 -beta evrima validate +quit
$prereq = Join-Path $dir 'Engine\Extras\Redist\en-us\UE4PrereqSetup_x64.exe'
if (Test-Path $prereq) {
  Write-Output 'Installing UE4 prerequisites (VC++ redistributables)...'
  $eap = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
  & $prereq /quiet /norestart
  $ErrorActionPreference = $eap
}
$cfgDir = Join-Path $dir 'TheIsle\Saved\Config\WindowsServer'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $cfgDir | Out-Null
$engineIni = Join-Path $cfgDir 'Engine.ini'
if ((-not (Test-Path $engineIni)) -or (-not (Select-String -Path $engineIni -Pattern 'EpicOnlineServices' -Quiet))) {
  Add-Content -Path $engineIni -Value "[EpicOnlineServices]`r`nDedicatedServerClientId=xyza7891gk5PRo3J7G9puCJGFJjmEguW`r`nDedicatedServerClientSecret=pKWl6t5i9NJK8gTpVlAxzENZ65P8hYzodV8Dqe5Rlc8" -Encoding ascii
  Write-Output 'Wrote [EpicOnlineServices] block to Engine.ini'
}
$ship = Join-Path $dir 'TheIsle\Binaries\Win64\TheIsleServer-Win64-Shipping.exe'
if (Test-Path $ship) { Write-Output 'OK: Shipping server exe present.' } else { Write-Output 'WARNING: Shipping exe NOT found.' }
Write-Output 'Install complete.'

variables.name: Additional Launch Arguments
variables.description: Optional extra arguments appended to the server (leave blank for defaults). EOS credentials are NOT set here — they live in Engine.ini.
